package.title: 100 NTS Probability and Counting MCQs with Explanations

questions.question: A fair coin is tossed once. What is the probability of getting heads?
Two fair coins are tossed. What is the probability of getting exactly one head?
Three fair coins are tossed. What is the probability of getting at least one head?
A fair six-sided die is rolled. What is the probability that the result is even?
A fair six-sided die is rolled. What is the probability of getting a number greater than 4?
A fair six-sided die is rolled. What is the probability of getting a multiple of 3?
Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that their sum is 7?
Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that their sum is 8?
Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that both show the same number?
A bag contains 3 red and 2 blue balls. One ball is chosen at random. What is the probability that it is red?
A bag contains 4 red and 3 blue balls. Two balls are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
A bag contains 4 red and 3 blue balls. Two balls are drawn with replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
A bag contains 5 red and 4 blue balls. Two balls are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are blue?
One card is drawn from a standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that it is an ace?
One card is drawn from a standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that it is a jack, queen or king?
One card is drawn from a standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that it is red?
One card is drawn from a standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that it is not a spade?
Two cards are drawn without replacement from a standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that both are aces?
Two cards are drawn without replacement from a standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that exactly one is an ace?
An integer is selected uniformly from 1 through 10. What is the probability that it is divisible by 2 or 3?
An integer is selected uniformly from 1 through 20. What is the probability that it is prime?
An integer is selected uniformly from 1 through 12. What is the probability that it is a multiple of 4 or 6?
A spinner has 8 equal sectors, of which 3 are red. What is the probability that it lands on red?
If the probability of rain tomorrow is 0.35, what is the probability that it does not rain?
Events A and B are mutually exclusive, with P(A) = 0.40 and P(B) = 0.35. What is P(A or B)?
Events A and B are independent, with P(A) = 0.80 and P(B) = 0.30. What is P(A and B)?
In a group of 30 students, 12 study French. If a student is selected at random from those who study French, what is the probability that the student studies French?
A box contains 3 red and 2 blue balls. A red ball is drawn first and not replaced. What is the probability that the second ball is blue?
A fair six-sided die is rolled twice. What is the probability of getting at least one 6?
Four fair coins are tossed. What is the probability of getting exactly two heads?
In how many ways can 5 distinct books be arranged in a row?
What is the value of 7 factorial, written 7!?
How many different arrangements can be made from the letters of CAT, using each letter once?
How many distinct arrangements can be made from all the letters of LEVEL?
From 8 people, how many ways can a president and a vice-president be selected, with one person holding each role?
How many ways can 3 people be selected from a group of 7?
How many pairs can be selected from 10 people?
How many three-digit numbers can be formed from 1, 2, 3 and 4 without repeating a digit?
How many three-digit numbers can be formed from 0, 1, 2 and 3 without repeating a digit?
How many four-digit PINs can be made using digits 0 through 9 if repetition is allowed and leading zero is permitted?
How many four-digit PINs can be made using digits 0 through 9 without repetition, if leading zero is permitted?
How many three-letter strings can be formed from the 26-letter English alphabet if repetition is allowed?
In how many ways can 5 distinct people sit around a circular table, where rotations of the same seating are considered identical?
In how many ways can 6 distinct people sit around a circular table, where rotations of the same seating are considered identical?
A café offers 5 distinct flavours. How many ways can a customer choose 2 different flavours if order does not matter?
How many committees of 3 can be selected from 5 women if all committee members must be women?
A group has 4 men and 3 women. How many committees contain 2 men and 1 woman?
On a grid, a shortest route from the start to the finish requires 3 moves east and 2 moves north. How many such routes are there?
A shortest grid route consists of 2 moves right and 2 moves up. How many different shortest routes are possible?
Five distinct people sit in a row. If person A must sit at the left end, how many arrangements are possible?
Six distinct people sit in a row. In how many arrangements are two specified people seated next to each other?
Six distinct people sit in a row. In how many arrangements are two specified people not seated next to each other?
How many arrangements of 6 distinct objects have a specified object in the first position?
How many four-digit even numbers can be formed from 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 without repetition?
How many three-digit odd numbers can be formed from 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 without repetition?
How many three-digit numbers greater than 300 can be formed from 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 without repetition?
How many five-letter strings can be formed from 7 distinct letters without repeating a letter?
How many groups of 4 can be selected from 9 people?
A set contains 5 distinct items. How many non-empty subsets does it have?
How many binary strings of length 5 are possible?
How many ordered outcomes are possible when two standard six-sided dice are rolled?
How many possible sequences are there when 3 coins are tossed?
How many five-digit PINs are possible using digits 0 through 9 if repetition and leading zero are allowed?
How many four-digit numbers can be formed from the digits 1 through 9 if the digits must be in strictly increasing order?
A bag contains 3 red and 2 blue balls. Two balls are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
A bag contains 5 red and 3 blue balls. Two balls are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are blue?
A bag contains 4 red and 3 blue balls. Three balls are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that exactly 2 are red?
Two cards are drawn without replacement from a standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that exactly one card is a heart?
A card is selected uniformly from the 26 black cards in a standard deck. What is the probability that its rank is 8, 9 or 10?
Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that their sum is even?
Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that their sum is at most 4?
Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that at least one die shows 5?
Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that the difference between their results is exactly 1?
A fair spinner has 10 equal sectors numbered 1 through 10. What is the probability that it lands on a number greater than 6?
Independent events A and B have probabilities 0.7 and 0.4. What is the probability that neither event occurs?
Events A and B have P(A) = 0.45, P(B) = 0.60 and P(A and B) = 0.25. What is P(A or B)?
If P(A and B) = 0.20 and P(B) = 0.50, what is P(A given B)?
One of two boxes is selected at random. Box A contains 2 red and 1 blue ball; Box B contains 1 red and 3 blue balls. A ball is drawn from the selected box. What is the probability it is red?
A fair six-sided die is rolled twice. What is the probability that the sum of the two results is divisible by 12?
An integer is chosen uniformly from 1 through 50. What is the probability that it is divisible by 3 or 5?
Two different integers are chosen from 1 through 5, with each unordered pair equally likely. What is the probability their sum is even?
A group has 5 qualified and 3 unqualified applicants. Three are selected at random. What is the probability that at least 2 selected applicants are qualified?
A committee of 4 is selected from 6 men and 4 women. What is the probability it contains exactly 2 women?
A committee of 3 is selected from 4 women and 5 men. What is the probability it has at least one woman?
One card is drawn from a standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that it is an ace or a king?
Three cards are drawn without replacement from a standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that all three cards are from the same suit?
A four-digit code is selected uniformly from 0000 through 9999. What is the probability that the code is divisible by 5, treating the code as an integer from 0 to 9999?

A code consists of 2 letters followed by 2 digits. Letters are chosen from the 26-letter English alphabet and digits from 0 through 9, with repetition allowed. What is the probability that the two letters are different?
The letters A, B, C and D are randomly arranged in a row. What is the probability that A is first and B is last?
Five distinct people are randomly arranged in a row. What is the probability that two specified people are adjacent?
Three fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that all three results are different?
Three fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that exactly one die shows 6?
A fair coin is tossed 4 times. What is the probability of getting exactly 3 heads?
A trial succeeds with probability 0.2, independently on each attempt. What is the probability of at least one success in 5 attempts?
Two independent components work with probabilities 0.9 and 0.8. What is the probability that both work?
An integer is chosen uniformly from 1 through 100. What is the probability that it is a perfect square?
An integer is chosen uniformly from 1 through 100. What is the probability that it is composite?
A fair coin is tossed twice. Given that at least one toss is heads, what is the probability that both tosses are heads?
A fair six-sided die is rolled. Given that the result is greater than 3, what is the probability that it is even?
A box contains 3 red and 2 blue balls. Two balls are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that the second ball is red?
